messages:
incident-bot: Pager triggered — elevated TLS handshake failures from edge-gateway-eu (5xx handshake errors). Current handshake_fail_rate=18% (threshold 5%) across 3 AZs. First alert at 2034567890. Paging @alex (oncall).

alex: got it, I'm oncall. Acknowledge pager. looking at dash now. region EU most impacted. any customer-facing impact yet?

maya: seeing spikes in 502/524 from the edge in logs. TLS handshake errors correlate with client cert verify failures and 'ssl3_get_client_certificate:certificate verify failed' in the proxy logs.

priya: adding logs, here's the last 3 lines from edge-proxy-2:
```
[2026-11-02T14:05:12Z] ssl_handshake_error peer=10.1.2.4:443 error="SSL routines:tls_process_client_certificate:certificate verify failed"
[2026-11-02T14:05:12Z] connection_reset
[2026-11-02T14:05:13Z] proxied_request 502 client=172.20.5.12
```

alex: hmm, client cert verification failure. Did we just rotate the mutual CA bundle yesterday? @maya did the rotator run successfully?

maya: rotator job completed but there were warnings—some leaf cert thumbprints didn't match expected values during staging verification. I let it proceed because majority succeeded. Root CA rotated at 03:00 UTC.

sanjay: CS reporting increased error-retries from EU customers hitting the hosted API. Sending a short note: "We're aware of elevated TLS errors for some EU customers and are investigating. We'll update shortly." Want me to expand messaging?

alex: keep it short for now, no P0 external post. internal comms only. we'll update once we have mitigation.

priya: quick check — OCSP responses for the new intermediate are timing out from our OCSP responder pool (timeouts ~2500ms). Could be causing chain verification failures for clients that require stapling.

maya: I can spin up a fallback path — disable strict client cert verification on the edge layer for a short window to reduce 5xx while we fix the CA bundle. It will allow connections but still log cert issues. Thoughts?

alex: acceptable as short-lived mitigation. Do it per-AZ and monitor error rate. If we see no regression, propagate. Don't disable at control plane level. Must be reversible by script.

maya: executing: 
```bash
# disable strict verify on proxy
kubectl -n edge exec edge-proxy-2 -- sh -c 'sed -i "s/verify_client on/verify_client optional/" /etc/nginx/conf.d/tls.conf && nginx -s reload'
```

deploy-bot: rollout started for edge-proxy-2 (maya) — nginx reload triggered.

maya: done in eu-west-1a. initial result: handshake_fail_rate dropped from 18% -> 6% in that AZ. pushing to b and c now.

priya: while that's in progress, I'm triaging the rotator logs and OCSP path. Looks like our OCSP upstream (ocsp-int.example.net) returned 503 intermittently; rotator accepted the new intermediate despite stale OCSP for some clients. We should roll back to previous intermediate cert across the edge fleet until we verify OCSP stability.

alex: plan: 1) propagate optional client cert verify to all EU edge nodes (maya). 2) rollrotator back to previous intermediate cert (priya + rotator team) — fast rollback. 3) re-enable strict verify after rollback and OCSP healthy. 4) customer comms update. Agree?

maya: starting step 1 now. I'll use patched job that updates proxies in a rolling manner with 1 node at a time.

emily: FYI — I'm on CS standby to send targeted updates to impacted customers in EU after we confirm rollback.

priya: rotator rollback in progress. Command:
```bash
/opt/rotator/bin/rotate --target intermediate --rollback-to 20261031-prev-intermediate --region eu-west-1 --dry-run=false
```

deploy-bot: rotator: rollback job started by priya. Tracking id ro-203456-rollback

priya: rollback completed on control plane at 2034568102, pushing cert to edge fleet.

deploy-bot: cert push to edge-gateway-eu started; rolling update queued (parallelism=2).

maya: pushed optional verify to all EU edge nodes — handshake_fail_rate down to 4.2% cluster-wide. Good signal.

alex: great. keep rollback running. once fleet reports new intermediate, we'll re-enable strict verify and watch.

priya: fleet cert push finished at 2034568290. Verified new intermediate is the previous one (thumbprint matches). OCSP for that intermediate responding normally.

maya: re-enabling strict client cert verification on a single node to validate:
```bash
kubectl -n edge exec edge-proxy-3 -- sh -c 'sed -i "s/verify_client optional/verify_client on/" /etc/nginx/conf.d/tls.conf && nginx -s reload'
```

deploy-bot: nginx reload performed on edge-proxy-3 (maya).

maya: after enabling strict verification on edge-proxy-3, handshake_fail_rate stayed steady ~3.9% -> good. rolling stricter verify back across fleet.

alex: timeline & impact notes for postmortem:
- Incident start: 2034567890 (pager)
- Root cause: rotator accepted new intermediate while OCSP upstream intermittently returning 503s, causing some clients to fail chain verification
- Mitigation: temporarily relaxed client cert verification at edge -> rollback to previous intermediate -> re-enable strict verify. 
- Customer impact: elevated TLS handshake 5xx for EU customers, peak 18%, reduced to <5% after mitigation. No P0 customer escalation recorded.

sanjay: drafting customer-facing post-incident note now. I'll be brief: "We experienced TLS handshake failures due to certificate rotation + OCSP flapping. We've rolled back the intermediate cert and traffic has normalized. We'll follow up with root cause and remediation." Will share in #customer-communications for approval.

alex: good. action items: 
- priya: add OCSP health checks to the rotator and fail safe if OCSP stale (due: 24h)
- maya: run a canary of rotator with stricter verification in staging (due: 12h)
- infra: add monitoring alert for cert-thumbprint-drift during rotation (due: 48h)

priya: noted, creating follow-up tickets.

incident-bot: incident marked as mitigated at 2034568350. Moving to postmortem workflow. @everyone — handoff to postmortem owners.
